translation: Gathered as flowers in the sixth month, dried in the shade. The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 堯花 (yáohuā), flavor bitter, cold. It governs cold-damage and warm malaria, descends the twelve waters, breaks accumulations, great hard masses (大堅症瘕), sweeps and cleanses retained masses in the intestines and stomach (腸胃中留癖), and cold and heat from food and drink...
